name: Salary Certificate Generator
title: Salary Certificate Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Create a salary certificate that states the employee, designation, joining date and gross monthly salary in figures and words. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Fill in the employee details and print a salary certificate for a bank, embassy or landlord.
intro: A salary certificate confirms that a person works for you and what they earn. Employees ask for it when they apply for a bank loan, a visa or a rented home.
It is issued on the company letterhead and signed by an authorised person. Everything is made in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to BIZEASE.
how: Enter the employee name, CNIC, designation and joining date.
Enter the gross monthly salary. The tool writes it in words.
Say who it is for (a bank, an embassy).
Print it on your letterhead and sign it.
example: Employee Ali Khan, Accountant, joined 10 January 2022, gross salary Rs. 85,000. The certificate states "Rupees eighty-five thousand only".
mistakes: Writing net salary when the bank asks for gross.
Not saying who the certificate is for.
Leaving it unsigned or without the company stamp.
Issuing it for an employee who has left.

faq.a: Most banks and embassies ask for gross monthly salary, but check what they need. Change the wording in the box if the net figure is required.

faq.q: Is a salary certificate a legal document?
faq.a: It is a company statement. The company is responsible for its accuracy.
Yes, use the additional line box.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It is a sample format, not legal advice, and it does not check your employment terms against the law. Have important documents reviewed by a qualified adviser.
